essence: The next ritual focus is the beautiful all-limbed goddess Lakshmi at the side.
The officiant must be a qualified, lineage-born, Agama-learned Shiva twice-born.
A clear-minded second teacher may act when authorized by the primary guru.
After meditation, water should be offered with the heart mantra using both hands and a vessel.
Afterwards, Veda-knowers should be made to recite the auspicious-day declaration and hymns.
